item.title: Lacey Lane Officially Signs With AEW - Diva Dirt
item.description: Lacey Lane has reportedly signed with AEW. In a report by Fightful Select, Sean Ross Sapp confirms the signing. Lane has appeared recently in AEW and ROH including championship matches against Mina Shirakawa and Mercedes Moné. She is a former NXT and WWE Women’s Tag Team Champion and was released from WWE in May.
